testcase.name: functions that reach outside the query are refused, quoted or schema-qualified()
plain selects with named parameters compile to prepared-statement placeholders()
anything that writes, changes state or takes locks is refused wherever it appears()
only one statement is allowed - the classic stacked-query shapes()
Unicode-escaped identifiers and strings are refused - the U-ampersand bypass()
positional and bare placeholders cannot smuggle a value into the text()
every statement kind named by the contract is refused()
a comment cannot split or hide a keyword()
escape-string and dollar-quote lexing cannot be used to hide a second statement()
characters PostgreSQL would read differently are refused outside quoted text()
casts, CTEs, quoted identifiers and literals that look dangerous are fine()
a carriage return ends a line comment as in PostgreSQL()
further dangerous functions and credential relations are refused()
